zones.label: Consent and Communication
zones.summary: Clear consent, boundaries, testing conversations, and shared decisions are foundational.
facts: Communication cannot eliminate every health risk.

zones.label: Barrier Methods
zones.summary: Barrier methods can reduce some STI and pregnancy risks when used correctly and consistently.
facts: A clinician can explain use and fit.

zones.label: Contraception
zones.summary: Contraceptive methods differ in effectiveness, duration, side effects, access, and user control.
facts: Choice should be informed and voluntary.

zones.label: Testing and Vaccination
zones.summary: Testing can detect infections without symptoms, and vaccination prevents selected infections.

zones.label: Care and Follow-Up
zones.summary: Treatment, partner notification support, repeat testing, and ongoing care reduce harm.
facts: Privacy and access rules vary by location.
